lines.lyric_hangul: 내 기억의 구석 한켠에 자리 잡은 갈색 piano
lines.lyric_translation: The corner of my memory / A brown piano settled on one side

lines.lyric_hangul: 어릴 적 집 안의 구석 한 켠에 자리 잡은 갈색 piano
lines.lyric_translation: In the corner of my childhood house / A brown piano settled on one side

lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 기억해 내 키보다 훨씬 더 컸던
lines.lyric_translation: I remember that moment / Way taller than my height

lines.lyric: Galsaek piano geuge nal ikkeul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 갈색 piano 그게 날 이끌 때
lines.lyric_translation: The brown piano that guided me

lines.lyric_hangul: 널 우러러보며 동경했었네
lines.lyric_translation: I looked up to you / I yearned for you

lines.lyric_hangul: 작은 손가락으로 널 어루만질 때
lines.lyric_translation: When I touched you with my small finger

lines.lyric: “I feel so nice, mom I feel so nice”
lines.lyric_hangul: "I feel so nice, mom, I feel so nice"
lines.lyric_translation: I feel so nice mom I feel so nice

lines.lyric: Geujeo son gadeon daero geonildeon geonban
lines.lyric_hangul: 그저 손 가던 대로 거닐던 건반
lines.lyric_translation: I played the piano wherever my hands took me

lines.lyric_hangul: 그땐 너의 의미를 몰랐었네
lines.lyric_translation: I didn’t know your significance back then

lines.lyric_hangul: 바라보기만 해도 좋았던 그때
lines.lyric_translation: Back then I was content with just looking at you

lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 기억해 초등학교 무렵
lines.lyric_translation: I remember back / during my elementary school days

lines.lyric: Nae kiga neoui kiboda deo keojyeotdeon geuttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 키가 너의 키보다 더 커졌던 그때
lines.lyric_translation: When my height became taller than yours

lines.lyric_hangul: 그토록 동경했던 널 등한시하며
lines.lyric_translation: I neglected you when I once yearned for you so

lines.lyric_hangul: 백옥 같던 건반 그 위 먼지가 쌓여가며
lines.lyric_translation: On top of the white jade-like keyboard / Dust is piling on

lines.lyric_hangul: 방치됐던 네 모습 그때도 몰랐었지
lines.lyric_translation: Your image that has been neglected / Even then I didn’t know your significance

lines.lyric: Neoui uimi naega eodi itdeun hangsang neon geu jaril
lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 의미 내가 어디 있든 넌 항상 그자릴
lines.lyric_translation: No matter where I am

lines.lyric_hangul: 지켰으니 그런데 그게 마지막이 될 줄 몰랐네
lines.lyric_translation: You always defended that spot / But I didn’t know that would be the last

lines.lyric_hangul: 이대론 가지 마, you say...
lines.lyric_translation: You say don’t leave like this

lines.lyric_hangul: "내가 떠나도 걱정은 하지 마"
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t worry even if I leave

lines.lyric_hangul: "넌 스스로 잘 해낼 테니까"
lines.lyric_translation: You’ll do well on your own

lines.lyric_hangul: "널 처음 만났던 그때가"
lines.lyric_translation: I remember when I first met you

lines.lyric_hangul: "생각나 어느새 훌쩍 커버렸네 네가"
lines.lyric_translation: Before I knew it you grew up / Though we are putting an end to our relationship

lines.lyric_hangul: "우리 관계는 마침표를 찍지만"
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t ever feel sorry to me

lines.lyric_hangul: "절대 내게 미안해하지 마"
lines.lyric_translation: I will get to meet you again

lines.lyric: Eotteon hyeongtaerodeun nal dasi mannage doel geoya
lines.lyric_hangul: "어떤 형태로든 날 다시 만나게 될 거야"
lines.lyric_translation: no matter what form

lines.lyric_hangul: "그때 반갑게 다시 맞아줘"
lines.lyric_translation: Greet me happily then

lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 기억해 까맣게 잊고 있었던
lines.lyric_translation: I remember back then when I met you that / I had completely forgotten,

lines.lyric: Neol dasi majuhaetdeon ttae yeollesal muryeop
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 다시 마주했던 때 14살 무렵
lines.lyric_translation: when I was around 14

lines.lyric_hangul: 어색도 잠시 다시 널 어루만졌지
lines.lyric_translation: The awkwardness / was only for a moment, I touched you again

lines.lyric_hangul: 긴 시간 떠나있어도 절대 거부감 없이
lines.lyric_translation: Even though I was gone for a long time / Without repulsion

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 받아줬던 너, without you, I'm nothing
lines.lyric_translation: You accepted me / Without you there’s nothing

lines.lyric_hangul: 새벽을 지나서 둘이서 함께 맞는 아침
lines.lyric_translation: After the dawn, two of us / We welcomed the morning together

lines.lyric_hangul: 영원히 너는 나의 손을 놓지 마
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t let go of my hand forever,

lines.lyric: Nado dasi neol nohji anheul tenikka
lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 다시 널 놓지 않을 테니까
lines.lyric_translation: I won’t let go of you again either

lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 기억해 나의 십 대의 마지막을
lines.lyric_translation: I remember back then / We burned up the last of my teen’s

lines.lyric: Hamkke bultaewotdeon neo geurae han chi apdo
lines.lyric_hangul: 함께 불태웠던 너 그래 한 치 앞도
lines.lyric_translation: Yes the days when we couldn’t see an inch in front of us

lines.lyric_hangul: 뵈지 않던 그때 울고, 웃고
lines.lyric_translation: We laughed, we cried

lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 함께여서 그 순간조차 이제는 추억으로
lines.lyric_translation: Those days with you, / those moments are now in memories

lines.lyric_hangul: 박살난 어깰 부여잡고 말했지
lines.lyric_translation: I said, grasping my crushed shoulder

lines.lyric_hangul: 나 더 이상은 진짜 못하겠다고
lines.lyric_translation: I really can’t do any more

lines.lyric_hangul: 포기하고 싶던 그때마다 곁에서 넌 말했지
lines.lyric_translation: Every time I wanted to give up / By my side you said

lines.lyric: Saekkya neoneun jinjja hal su itdago
lines.lyric_hangul: "새꺄 너는 진짜 할 수 있다고"
lines.lyric_translation: Bastard you can really do it

lines.lyric_hangul: 그래, 그래, 그때 기억해 지치고 방황했었던
lines.lyric_translation: Yeah, yeah / I remember back then / When I was fed up and lost

lines.lyric_hangul: 절망의 깊은 수렁에 빠졌던 그때
lines.lyric_translation: Back then when I fell into a pit of despair

lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 널 밀어내고 널 만난 걸 원망해도
lines.lyric_translation: Even when I pushed you away / Even when I resented meeting you

lines.lyric: Neon kkutkkusi nae gyeoteul jikyeoji mal an haedo
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 꿋꿋이 내 곁을 지켰지 말 안 해도
lines.lyric_translation: You were firmly by my side

lines.lyric_hangul: 그러니 절대 너는 내 손을 놓지 마
lines.lyric_translation: You didn’t have to say anything / So don’t ever let go of my hand

lines.lyric: Du beon dasi naega neol nohji anheul tenikka
lines.lyric_hangul: 두 번 다시 내가 널 놓지 않을 테니까
lines.lyric_translation: I won’t let you go ever again either

lines.lyric: Naui tansaeng geurigo nae salmui kkeut
lines.lyric_hangul: 나의 탄생 그리고 내 삶의 끝
lines.lyric_translation: My birth and the end of my life

lines.lyric: Geu modeun geol jikyeobol neoil tenikka
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 모든 걸 지켜볼 너일 테니까
lines.lyric_translation: You will be there to watch over it all

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 기억의 구석 한 켠에 자리잡은 갈색 piano
lines.lyric_translation: The corner of my memory / A brown piano settled on one side

lines.lyric_hangul: 어릴 적 집 안의 구석 한 켠에 자리잡은 갈색 piano
lines.lyric_translation: In the corner of my childhood house / A brown piano settled on one side
